visual_logic.composition: A quadrant tiled composition: Top-Left (Birth): An ootheca (egg case) hidden in bark splitting open to reveal tiny, pale nymphs; Top-Right (Dining): The cockroach nibbling on a fallen, decaying Cretaceous fruit; Bottom-Left (Sleeping): Dozens of cockroaches huddled together in the dark hollow of a tree; Bottom-Right (Playing/Activity): A cockroach scurrying rapidly across a dry leaf, its long antennae blurred with motion.
visual_logic.style_notes: Avoid making them 'gross'; use warm browns and ambers to give them a 'forest-critter' feel compatible with the toy-like style.
